title: SDK cohort curriculum & iteration tracker for quickstart adoption
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create and run a repeatable SDK Quickstart Cohort program (4-week curriculum) that ties to DX OKRs. Deliverables: cohort curriculum, playbook for onboarding engineers, measurement dashboard (activation/time-to-first-call/quickstart completion), and a lightweight retrospective template. Program should integrate with docs, sample apps, and Console walkthroughs.
acceptance_criteria: Publish a 4-week cohort curriculum with weekly learning objectives and exercises
Ship a one-page cohort playbook for Solutions Engineers and PMs describing logistics, materials, and success signals
Dashboard in Looker/Grafana with cohort-level metrics: new SDK installs, time-to-first-call, quickstart completion rate, retention after 14 days
Run pilot cohort with at least 8 participant teams and collect structured feedback
Document retrospective with three actionable changes and owners for next cohort
tasks: Draft curriculum outline and map to existing quickstarts (week-by-week)
Work with DevRel to produce two new sample apps (Node + Python) that cover streaming and function calls
Coordinate with Docs to create a condensed cohort handbook and 2 short video walkthroughs
Instrument quickstarts with telemetry events for cohort metrics and add tags to identify cohort traffic
Build a Looker dashboard tile for cohort KPIs and connect to activation events
Recruit pilot cohort participants via PLG usage signals and SE outreach
Run pilot: kickoff, weekly check-ins, day-28 survey, retrospective session
Iterate on playbook and curriculum based on pilot feedback; schedule next cohort
